name: Witchwing Talon
summary: In the northwestern Barrens, Witchwing Talons mark fallen harpy raiders. At the Crossroads, Horde scouts seek them as proof while working to secure vital caravan routes.

sections.title: Trophies from the Roosts
sections.body: Witchwing harpies raid Horde supply caravans from roosts northwest of the Crossroads. Scout Darsok Swiftdagger coordinates strikes against the flock's hierarchy. He requires proof that each scavenger has been killed, and the talons provide it. With proof of their fall, the scouts can thin the flock before striking higher in its command.

faq.q: Who wants Witchwing Talons and why?
faq.answer: Darsok Swiftdagger, an orc scout at the Crossroads, collects Witchwing Talons. He plans a campaign against the Witchwing brood and requires eight as proof that its frontline raiders have been slain.
Harpies in the northwestern Barrens carry Witchwing Talons. They include common harpies and Witchwing Roguefeathers, which nest along the cliffs and dry ridges.

faq.q: Why are the Witchwing harpies being targeted?
faq.answer: The Witchwing flock has grown increasingly bold, attacking Horde supply lines and trade caravans across the Barrens. Darsok aims to thin its lower ranks before striking its lieutenants and matriarch.

angles.text: Caravans connect Kalimdor's scattered Horde outposts. Clearing the harpy roosts helps secure the frontier.
Darsok Swiftdagger values quiet, precise attacks. To him, these sharp claws mark the work of a skilled killer against aerial predators.
